method_definition: GLM-5.3 at low reasoning effort through the GLM Coding Plan and OpenCode generated Blender Python scene code for Table 2; retained final Blender meshes are reused for Table 3 without another model request

structural_metrics.reason: The frozen final output has meshes and descriptive Blender node names but no stable independent-instance graph, unified object roles, or native support edges.

pilot.acceptance_gate: All planned pilot slots terminal; every eligible Table-2 mesh reaches evaluation or a deterministic registered ITT failure; no new runner failure; at least one evaluated geometry per domain
pilot.acceptance_note: Both reviewed plots use the registered ROI and spawn convention; all six reusable pilot meshes reached terminal evaluation and all fourteen unavailable Table-2 slots were retained as ITT zeros.

reuse.eligible: frozen GLM identity, generation_success=true, build_success=true, retained scene.blend, and SUCCESS marker

coordinate_system: Blender meters, Z up, evaluation region centered at X=Y=0

navigation.aggregation: mean over the four seeds inside each specification, then mean over 25 specifications

blender.gpu_reason: Canonical mesh export performs no rendering or neural inference; Blender dependency-graph and Recast operations are CPU-only

python_environment.purpose: Existing Python 3.11 environment for NumPy and the frozen Recast extension; no downloads required

billing: No Table-3 model request; only retained Table-2 artifacts are read

amendments.stage: after the first formal export attempt and before aggregation or reporting
amendments.reason: Six reusable Urban Blender files deterministically contained no upward triangles selected by the frozen pedestrian-surface rules, and one reusable Indoor file deterministically had no node matching the frozen indoor-floor rule. Both outcomes mean that the retained final geometry cannot enter the registered surface evaluator.
amendments.effect: Preserve Table-2 source eligibility at 42/100 Indoor and 19/100 Urban; classify one Indoor and six Urban canonical-unusable slots as Table-3 ITT, yielding 41 evaluated plus 59 ITT Indoor slots and 13 evaluated plus 87 ITT Urban slots. No model, scene, semantic rule, threshold, navigation formula, or aggregate value was changed after observation.
